name: Berlin, A Rough Cut
description: Opening March 7, this group exhibition explores Berlin's constant state of transformation through the eyes of contemporary artists who give meaning to the seemingly insignificant traces of daily existence. With wit and poetic precision, the artists capture the city as a living, unfinished archive—a reflection on time and space that holds the present as a fleeting film still before it disappears. The exhibition invites viewers to see Berlin not as a fixed place but as an ongoing process of becoming, where architecture, memory, and everyday life intersect.
